prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for original 2D side-scrolling military walker game ORDRE DE CENDRE, Vesper planet. High-quality painted science-fiction game art, near orthographic SIDE ELEVATION at ground level, no isometric or top down view. Matte slate, dusty ash ochre, weathered grey-green metal, muted rust, subdued brass details, soft ivory light from upper left. Readable realistic materials and restrained contrast. TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENCY outside the separate objects. No background, no white or black panels, no gradients outside objects, no fog, no cast shadows, no ground plane beyond the requested material. No text, letters, numbers, logos, captions, borders, grid lines, watermarks, people, machines, or unrelated objects. Generous fully transparent gutters separating each cell, no crossing between cells. Create FOUR separate rectangular cutaway EARTH MATERIAL PANELS in a STRICT two-column two-row atlas. Each panel is about twice as wide as tall, square-on vertical exposed geological face, isolated. Upper edge is horizontal compacted dusty ochre crust a few centimetres thick; immediately below are weathered dark slate and basalt strata with thin warm rust seams and fine gritty ash. Row1 left layered thin shale bands, row1 right denser craggy basalt bands; row2 left slate with subtle ochre sediment pockets, row2 right broken angular scoria embedded in finer ash. ALL four panels share compatible colors and density with dark lower edges and nearly straight left and right boundaries so the game can repeat them as terrain textures. The four panels are simple horizontal material swatches, with NO perspective ledge, no rock mound and no extra objects. Even spacing and at least 30 pixels of entirely transparent gutter around every panel. Visible material only, no labels or fake checkerboard.
